impactBody: Our work spans Queensland, Australian reservoirs, Honiara, the Tina River, Bina Harbour and Rennell Island. Programs are shaped with government, utilities, communities and regional organisations.
Delivery includes field monitoring, operational data systems, training and environmental assessment, with a focus on lasting local capability.
